setup.dealing: Five cards face down to each player, then five cards face down to the table. Dealer turns table cards face up one at a time; after each card a betting round. Clockwise from dealer.

rules.objective: Win the pot by having the highest five-card poker hand, formed from any combination of your five hole cards and the five community cards.
rules.gameplay: 1. Deal: five cards face down to each player and five face down to the table. 2. Players look at their hands. 3. Dealer turns the table cards face up one at a time; after each card is turned there is a round of betting (check, bet, call, raise, or fold). 4. After the fifth and final betting round, showdown: each active player's hand is the best five-card hand from any combination of their hole cards and the five table cards. 5. Highest hand wins the pot.
keyRules: Each player has five hole cards; five community cards are revealed one by one with a betting round after each.
Best five-card hand uses any combination of the player's five hole cards and the five community cards.
Standard poker hand rankings determine the winner; standard betting order applies (e.g. check, bet, call, raise, fold).

list.name: High card of suit splits pot
list.description: Holder of the highest card of the suit of a particular table card (often the last or third turned) splits the pot with the highest hand. Alternatively: high hand splits with holder of highest card of that suit if table card is 8 or higher, or with lowest card of the suit if 7 or lower.
list.emptyOverridesReason: Variant only changes pot-split and wild rules; no engine constant overrides needed.

list.name: Last table card wild
list.description: The last table card turned over and all cards of the same rank are wild.
list.emptyOverridesReason: Variant only changes wild cards; no engine constant overrides needed.

list.name: Low Hole Cincinnati
list.description: Each player's lowest hole card is wild for that player, along with any others of the same rank.
list.emptyOverridesReason: Variant only changes wild cards per player; no engine constant overrides needed.

ante.reason: This game has no ante or betting.

deal.reason: Deal is performed by the dealer; not a player action.

reveal_market.reason: This game does not use a market to reveal.

buy_market.reason: This game has no market purchase.

buy_stock.reason: This game has no buying from stock.

fold.description: Forfeit the hand and withdraw from the current pot; no further action in this hand.
fold.constraints: Legal during any betting round when it is your turn to act.

check.description: Decline to bet and pass action to the next player; only legal when no bet has been made in the current round.
check.constraints: Legal only when no one has bet in the current betting round.

call.description: Match the current bet to stay in the hand.
call.constraints: Legal when at least one player has bet in the current round and you have not yet acted or matched.

bet.description: Place a bet; subsequent players must call, raise, or fold.
bet.constraints: Legal when no bet has been made in the current round (or when table rules allow opening bet).

raise.description: Increase the current bet; subsequent players must call the new amount, re-raise, or fold.
raise.constraints: Legal when a bet has already been made in the current round; must be at least the minimum raise.

declare.reason: This game has no declare phase.

reveal_hand.description: Reveal hole cards at showdown so the best five-card hand from hole and community cards can be determined.
reveal_hand.constraints: Occurs at showdown when more than one player remains; order may follow table rules (e.g. last aggressor first).

award_pot.description: Give the pot to the player with the highest five-card hand (or split per house rules).
award_pot.constraints: After all hands are revealed at showdown; typically performed by dealer or system.

play_card.reason: Cincinnati is community-card poker; players do not play cards to the table, only bet between community card reveals.

engine.deckDescription: A standard 52-card French deck comprising four suits: Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, and Spades. Each suit contains thirteen ranks: Ace, 2 through 10, Jack, Queen, and King, providing versatile options for various card games.
engine.suitDescription: Four traditional French suits: Hearts (Cœur), Diamonds (Carreau), Clubs (Trèfle), and Spades (Pique), each represented with standard French card iconography and distinct color coding for easy identification.
engine.rankDescription: Standard thirteen ranks per suit: Ace, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, Jack, Queen, and King, where each rank has distinct value and meaning depending on the specific game rules and player strategies.
engine.dealPattern: 5 cards each to players, then 5 cards to table (community).
